purpose: Candidate axes for osu!standard skill profiling. This is NOT a final taxonomy and NOT a ground-truth definition; every entry is a provisional hypothesis to be tested with data.
model_version_separation: model_version and taxonomy_version are independent fields in every output. Changing one never implies the other.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to place cursor accurately and quickly onto distant, isolated targets.
skills.not: Not a measure of raw distance alone; not a label for maps that merely have large spacing with slow rhythm.
candidate_signals: short delta times on large distances
skills.known_ambiguity: Large spacing can also be driven by reading difficulty; jump_aim may overlap with precision and reading at high AR.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to move cursor smoothly through connected, curved patterns without stopping.
skills.not: Not the same as slider play; not a measure of discrete jumps.
skills.known_ambiguity: Flow maps often contain sliders, so flow_aim and slider_complexity can correlate in naive feature space.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to hit small targets and short, tightly spaced movements with high accuracy.
skills.not: Not a synonym for accuracy stat (OD); OD is context, not skill evidence by itself.
skills.known_ambiguity: Short tightly spaced patterns are also speed patterns; precision and speed share the same raw spacing signals.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to handle unusual, uncomfortable cursor paths that resist learned muscle memory.
skills.not: Not a measurable feature from geometry alone; it is a claim about human difficulty and therefore needs annotation.
skills.known_ambiguity: This is the least objectively defined aim axis; geometry signals are weak and must not be treated as evidence without human validation.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to tap short clusters of notes at high rate.
skills.not: Not a measure of sustained streams; not a measure of finger alternation skill.
skills.known_ambiguity: Short bursts at the same BPM as streams differ only in length, making the burst/stream boundary a label decision, not a raw measurement.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to tap long continuous runs of equally spaced notes.
skills.not: Not a measure of finger independence; not stamina by itself.
candidate_signals: low interval diversity within the section
skills.known_ambiguity: Long streams also demand stamina; separating stream skill from stamina requires duration-controlled comparison.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to tap at high BPM with acceptable accuracy.
skills.not: Not the same as map BPM; BPM is context and speed is the human response to it.
skills.known_ambiguity: High BPM dense sections also recruit stamina; speed and stamina are confounded in short maps.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to sustain high tapping rate over time without degradation.
skills.not: Not a single-map local property; it is inherently duration-dependent and must be evaluated over sustained sections.
candidate_signals: late-map density relative to early-map density
skills.known_ambiguity: A map can be dense but short; calling that stamina would be a category error without duration normalization.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to execute uneven, alternating or non-standard tap patterns.
skills.not: Not a measure of raw speed; not derivable from a single rhythm statistic.
skills.known_ambiguity: Rhythm irregularity may be a reading problem rather than a tapping problem; separating the two needs annotation.

skills.provisional_definition: Ability to perceive and react to object patterns under time pressure, especially with high approach rate or unusual spacing.
skills.not: Not a feature that can be computed from geometry alone; AR is context, not reading skill.
skills.known_ambiguity: Reading is a perceptual skill; no deterministic feature can prove it without player data.

skills.provisional_definition: Rhythmic irregularity and diversity of intervals in the map.
skills.not: Not a claim that the map is hard to read for any specific player.
skills.known_ambiguity: Irregular rhythm can be easy for a skilled reader; complexity is a property of the pattern, difficulty is a property of the player.

skills.provisional_definition: Complexity contributed by slider geometry, repeats, length and velocity.
skills.not: Not a measure of aim; not a measure of slider accuracy (player-side).
skills.known_ambiguity: Sliders with many repeats are also rhythmically dense; slider complexity overlaps rhythm_complexity.

convenience_labels.definition: A convenience label that may later be derived from multiple atomic skills. It is NOT an atomic skill and must never be used as a base label.
convenience_labels.note: The exact derivation rule is deliberately undefined until human annotation exists.
